from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document relevant to filtering by cause of action."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the document, e.g., '民事执行复议裁定书' or specific case title")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) or procedural type described in the document, e.g., '虚开增值税专用发票罪', '案外人执行异议之诉'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated extraction from the processed document."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
